name: AWR 报告综合分析方法论
description: AWR 报告的系统性分析方法：从 Load Profile 看负载量 → Top Events 看瓶颈方向 → SQL Statistics 看具体 SQL → Instance Efficiency 看整体健康 → Segment Statistics 看热点对象。核心是 DB Time 分解和等待事件分类。

skip_when.desc: 问题已通过 ASH 实时定位

root_causes.name: AWR 报告解读不系统
root_causes.desc: 直接跳到 Top SQL 而忽略 Load Profile 和 Top Events 的宏观视角。

root_causes.name: DB Time 分解不清
root_causes.desc: 未区分 CPU Time 和 Wait Time，无法判断是 CPU 瓶颈还是等待瓶颈。

root_causes.name: AWR 快照间隔不当
root_causes.desc: 间隔过长（如 4 小时）稀释了问题时段的严重性。

root_causes.name: 单快照 vs 对比分析
root_causes.desc: 只看单个 AWR 报告而不与正常时段对比，无法判断变化。

oltp.desc: DB Time/elapsed = 活动会话数，OLTP 正常 < CPU 数

olap.desc: OLAP 并行查询时 DB Time 高是正常的

step1_generate_awr.sql:
SELECT 1 AS placeholder FROM dual -- -- @$ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin/awrrpt.sql
SELECT snap_id, begin_interval_time, end_interval_time FROM dba_hist_snapshot ORDER BY snap_id DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step2_load_profile.sql: SELECT metric_name, ROUND(AVG(value), 2) avg_value FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE metric_name IN ('DB Time Per Sec', 'DB Block Gets Per Sec', 'Physical Reads Per Sec', 'Redo Generated Per Sec', 'User Calls Per Sec', 'Executions Per Sec') AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR GROUP BY metric_name

step3_top_events.sql: SELECT event_name, wait_class, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6, 2) time_waited_sec, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000, 2) avg_wait_ms FROM dba_hist_system_event se JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON se.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR AND wait_class != 'Idle' ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step4_top_sql_by_elapsed.sql: SELECT sql_id, ROUND(elapsed_time_delta/1e6, 2) elapsed_sec, executions_delta execs, ROUND(elapsed_time_delta/GREATEST(executions_delta,1)/1000, 2) avg_ms, ROUND(buffer_gets_delta/GREATEST(executions_delta,1)) gets_per_exec FROM dba_hist_sqlstat ss JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON ss.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR ORDER BY elapsed_time_delta DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
